name: Fortune Sheet
tagline: A local Excel-like spreadsheet. Your workbook lives in the icon, not in anyone's cloud.
description:
Fortune Sheet is a full spreadsheet in the sandbox: cells, formulas, formatting, freeze, sort, filter, comments, and as many sheets as you need. Type a budget, a roster, a grade book — it stays on this device, inside the app's GIF. There is no account and no server of theirs (or ours) that your numbers ever visit.

It opens on a small demo sheet so you can see formulas working, then it is yours. Every edit is written into gifos.db a moment after you make it; close the app and come back, the grid is where you left it. New workbook wipes the grid, not the GIF.

An unofficial port of FortuneSheet by ruilisi, MIT-licensed — a TypeScript rewrite of Luckysheet that dropped jQuery. Their collaboration backend is not in this app: we never send an Op, we never open a socket, and connect-src stays closed. What you type is saved here, not synced to a service.
